entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that offers a universal memory layer for User, Session, and Agent states. It supports temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval and is available as an OSS SDK, self-hosted server, or managed cloud.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider featuring a custom vector graph engine and hybrid RAG search. It maintains user profiles through automated fact extraction and provides connectors for Google Drive, Gmail, Notion, OneDrive, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes the viking:// protocol for deterministic context browsing. It implements tiered L0/L1/L2 data loading and provides observable retrieval with directory-browsing trajectories.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It supports multi-user scoping for team institutional memory and creates typed edges without LLM calls.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and offers Docker-based deployment options.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for building stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with Python and TypeScript SDKs.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control via brv vc commit, branch, and merge. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI/REPL interface.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for sub-millisecond performance. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and provides a Python SDK for direct memory operations.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: A seven-layer memory system that includes vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It uses a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure agents prioritize injected context within a local infrastructure of Docker, Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive self-improving context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers, including Pi and MCP clients, and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no message is lost. It utilizes a SQLite message store with FTS metadata to build depth-aware summary nodes.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent. It supports local inference servers or any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.plur-ai/plur: This shared memory layer uses an open engram YAML format to store memory as plain-text. It provides local-first, zero-cost search and supports Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: This local-first layer manages identity, memory, and secrets to provide portable state across Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, OpenClaw, and MCP clients. It features tools for memory inspection, editing, and deletion and reports a 97.6% average LongMemEval answer accuracy.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine operates fully locally without API keys or cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval via BM25 and vector search to support Hermes, Claude Code, and OpenClaw agents.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool accelerates long context LLM inference through block reordering and deduplication for prefix reuse. It is a native plugin for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems that can reduce prefill latency by 1.5–3×.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: This durable, file-based memory architecture uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases or embeddings. It is delivered via a five-package plugin family including a Hermes adapter and an MCP server.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This self-maintaining plugin is embedded by default and provides explainable retrieval via a why_retrieved tag. It includes recency-aware ranking, contradiction tracking, and a loop for identifying knowledge gaps.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory uses RAG and vector search to prefetch context by monitoring agent session logs. It features local-first storage using SQLite-vec and GGUF models via node-llama-cpp.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: This memory kernel stack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent per query.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: This reflective memory system uses semantic search with BM25 full-text and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for URLs, codebases, and multimedia with OCR support, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces Hermes Agent v0.14.0 prompt token overhead through keyword selection and local BM25 tool ranking. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated schema token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: This local-first context layer resolves live workspace state into verified facts to reduce prompt tokens. It supports MCP via stdio or SSE and renders context for various assistant profiles.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This daemonless memory system stores information as inspectable Markdown files, allowing users to use an Obsidian vault as a source of truth. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin utilizes a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features importance-weighted recall via a 1-10 ranking system and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports immediate event deletion and an on-demand summarizer. It provides an audit trace of all memory operations through a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider offers durable, cross-session memory storage featuring semantic search capabilities. It includes specific tools for remembering, searching, and updating state to support cross-agent continuity for user-approved memories.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across multiple chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes to facilitate automated payments.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides indexing and routing for local capabilities, including skills, scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, and MCP servers. It offers five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider features 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It employs a hybrid search method combining BM25, vector, and graph techniques, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private, local code memory for repositories, running over localhost. It supports semantic and literal code search, as well as grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution provides AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW, sparse, FM-index, and bitmap indexing. It offers both native Rust FFI and HTTP daemon execution modes.

entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams. It provides unified skill libraries across devices and automates quality improvement and deduplication.

entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: An MIT-licensed library of markdown-based professional skills that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes ready-to-paste exports for Gemini, ChatGPT, Codex, and Cursor.

entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables the agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This library provides type-safe support for agentskills.io through modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports remote registries.

entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill facilitates literate programming by generating.lit.md files that combine prose, diagrams, and source code. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: This harness supports long-running agents through a three-level work model and structured memory using file-backed or SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin provides cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It includes a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This project integrates CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds via the Agent Skills specification. It includes specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to facilitate smart contract interaction.

entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces such as CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality scores and token savings in a local SQLite database.
